'''Armor''' in Matcha Flavoured comes in thirteen sets. Base-metal sets are crafted; alloy sets are smithed onto copper, iron or diamond armor. Several sets have intrinsics, and the [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] and [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] sets have a [[Set bonus|set bonus]].

In the video, the developer wanted every set to be "enticing enough that every player will have a different idea on what the best set and combination is."{{Cite video|quote=The goal with these sets was to make each option enticing enough that every player will have a different idea on what the best set and combination is.}}

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Set !! Armor !! Toughness !! Notes
|-
| [[Copper equipment|Copper]] || 10 || 0 || 
|-
| [[Iron equipment|Iron]] || 15 || 0 || 
|-
| [[Steel equipment|Steel]] || 16 || 4 || Steel is the alloy tier of iron: very durable, and its weapons and armor add knockback and blast resistance.
|-
| [[Golden equipment|Golden]] || 12 || 0 || Golden equipment carries [[Fortune]], [[Looting]] and [[Fire Protection]] as intrinsics.
|-
| [[Diamond equipment|Diamond]] || 20 || 8 || 
|-
| [[Shakudo equipment|Shakudo]] || 20 || 0 || Its tools have [[Silk Touch]], its weapons steal life and its armor regenerates health and cleanses effects.
|-
| [[Hepatizon equipment|Hepatizon]] || 20 || 0 || It has the highest mining speeds in the pack and every piece adds movement speed.
|-
| [[Electrum equipment|Electrum]] || 20 || 12 || Its tools are the only source of Fortune III, and its armor and weapons carry [[Warding]].
|-
| [[Adamant equipment|Adamant]] || 20 || 12 || Its armor carries [[Doom]], its weapons inflict Weakness and its tools smelt what they mine.
|-
| [[Leather armor|Leather]] || 7 || 0 || Leather armor is crafted from tattered leather, the item [[Zombie|zombies]] drop, and every piece adds safe fall distance.
|-
| [[Sturdy leather armor|Sturdy Leather]] || 12 || 0 || Sturdy leather armor is a stronger leather set with Projectile Protection and extra safe fall distance.
|-
| [[Chainmail armor|Chainmail]] || 15 || 0 || Chainmail armor is craftable from iron chains and every piece has Thorns III.
|}
